Results.ReviewText: I decided to replace my 25-year-old Weber kettle. I cannot tell you how delighted I am that I upgraded to the master touch, everything about it is just perfection from the char baskets to the lid holder and thermometer. I have a Weber Genesis 2 propane grill however I'm going back to my roots and I'm all about charcoal again! it's just a more immersive experience not to mention more flavor, if you have the extra scratch I highly recommend spending it on this beauty, I promise you will love it, and thank you Weber for "made in USA"
Results.Title: Simply perfection!

Results.ReviewText: Je suis extrêmement satisfait, j’envisage m’en acheter un 26’’ ou un performer premium.
Results.Title: Service parfait

Results.ReviewText:
I've had my MasterTouch for nearly five years, and it's been one of the best purchases I've ever made. I've cooked everything from burgers and hot dogs to barbecue and rotisserie chicken on it, and I consistently get great results. If there's one thing I wish was better, it's the seal around the lid. I've used third-party gaskets to stop smoke (and heat) leaking out between the lid and bowl, and they do the trick, but the adhesive on those fails when winter comes and I grill year-round in the upper Midwest. Temperature consistency is fine either way, the leaky seal just means that it takes more charcoal to reach the desired temperature. 

Overall, a very good product that I consistently use at least a couple times a week.
Results.Title: Absolute workhorse

Results.ReviewText: I've used this grill three times since I bought it a few weeks ago. All the cooks have turned out fantastic, I couldn't ask for more, though I'm leaning towards getting some accessofies for my master touch 22.5 weber. Love it!
Results.Title: This is everything I could ask for in a kettle.

Results.ReviewText: Pour avoir maintenant 3 mastertouch. 2 pour la maison et 1 pour transporter. Les possibilité de cuisson et fumage sont simplement exeptionel juste besoin d acheté un bon thermometre digital a 2 ou 4 sonde pour passer de steak au 4 longe de porc en slow cooking et fumé
Results.Title: Versatile a souhaiy

Results.ReviewText: Unbelievable ease of use. Huge step up from basic kettle.
Results.Title: Great usable charcoal grill

Results.ReviewText: After about 15 years the one touch ash lever rotted out on the inside of my 18" Webber, so I decided to upgrade to the Webber Master Touch 22" grill.  I love this grill.  The shape of the kettle circulates the heat throughout the grill which allows the temperature to recover really fast if you take the lid off.   Since the heat circulates it really helps cook everything evenly.  My burgers and steaks turn out perfect.  I use a chimney to start the mesquite lump charcoal to cook everything which is my personal favorite type of wood to use.  You can't go wrong with a Webber kettle grill.
Results.Title: Awesome grill; perfect design!

Results.ReviewText: On the top grate, two out of the four bent tabs that keep the side flaps on the wire grate were not bent enough so when you fold them, one side would fall off into the coals. Easy fix by myself with vise grips, but shouldn't have had to do that, just poor quality assurance for part fitment.
Results.Title: Poor Quality Assurance

Results.ReviewText: Good grill overall. Great customer service. Missing part promptly shipped. Center removable grate tends to slip out of place when cleaning, otherwise it’s great

ClientResponses.Response: Hi! Thank you for being a long time Weber fan! We greatly appreciate your feedback regarding the Master Touch grill. We are so sorry to learn your grill is wobbly and the color is not what you expected. The grill should not be wobbly. We would want to be sure the legs are assembled correctly. Also, regarding adjusting the air flow, using the top vents will also help bring down the temperature if you close them slightly. Our team has reached out via email to discuss further with you. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: Assembly took a while.  Once fully assembled and everything tightened down, the legs are still a bit wobbly.  For this price point, I expected a better quality setup.  Color in person is not as colorful as shown on website.  Mainly bought this for the Master-Touch features, specifically the feathering of the bottom intake / ash removal system.  Design theory is good, however actual practice is there is not enough movement on the impellers to fully clean the ash afterwards.  I also tried adjusting temperature by changing the air intake and smoke outlets; nothing I did really changed the internal temperature.  Ash bin is secure and very handy.  Also like the thicker wire used for the grates, and how the grate removal parts are setup.  Works just fine as a normal charcoal grill, but not sure that I would buy this again.
Results.Title: Moderately Impressed

Results.ReviewText: Solid construction.  Great sealing for temperature control.  Previously purchased a differnt brand after using Weber my entire life, what a mistake.  I'm back to Weber!
Results.Title: Accept no Imitations

Results.ReviewText: Easy to clean. Beautiful color. Consistent heat. Great features. Hope the grill is durable!

Results.ReviewText: This is my first charcoal grill. I’ve been loving it! Great results every time. Their customer service is great also. Mine came with a ding in the lid. They replaced it right away!

Results.ReviewText: Versatility. Use with firedial, charcoal ring, expander ring, more room for extended indirect cooking & smoking.  Slow & sear and cast iron grates and vortex.  Bought as a second grill to my 22" kettle.

Results.ReviewText: Can’t beat the original charcoal grill, never had one with the clean out at the bottom, awesome addition. Love the grate system and all the additional items for grilling. You’ve come a long way Weber Kettle.
Results.Title: Great Original Kettle

Results.ReviewText: 2 semaines plus tard ...tourne briche , pizza ,steak, un vrais charme
Results.Title: Jusre parfait !

Results.ReviewText: have had a weber e-series gas grill for over 8 years, longest i've had a grill either gas or charcoal. just have to replace a few parts. gave up on charcoal grills that long ago. none held up very well .wanted to get back into charcoal grilling. saw the master touch grill on display at lowe's and liked what i saw. they of course were out of stock. went on to bbq guys and ordered one. have grilled a few simple things [chicken, hot sausage] very pleased with the construction and ease of use and clean up

Results.ReviewText: I've wanted one of these for years and my wife bought me one for our anniversary. It's amazing how much heat you can get from the charcoal compared to a barrel grill. I will likely use it in -30 this winter!
Results.Title: Love This Grill!

Results.ReviewText:
Un barbecue avec une foule de possibilités, un produit bien conçu avec des matériaux de qualité.  Les contrôles d'aération supérieures et à la base sont efficaces et que dire du cendrier, le cendrier rend l'élimination des cendres un jeu d'enfant.
Toutefois j'aurais peut-être apprécié que le couvercle soit monté sur charnières, mais aufinal c'est un excellent produit.

14501001.Name: 22” Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill
14501001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill. This grill features a handy Tuck-Away Lid Holder that gives you a convenient place to nest the lid against the side of the bowl, a hinged cooking grate that fits circular GBS accessories so you can explore more ways to cook, a built-in lid thermometer, and legs that are 2” taller than standard kettles. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retain heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate fits circular GBS grillware· Included Char-Rails make it easy to arrange charcoal· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Tuck-Away Lid Holder provides handy space to hang lid· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels.· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant and 2” taller· 10-year limited warranty
